card.description: Students using the OnTrack homework app during one school week. Each student is labeled On Track or Needs Check-in. The app records how many assignments each student submitted in the app, what time they submitted, and how long they spent in the app. A student is labeled On Track when all 5 assignments were submitted in the app before 9 PM. The teacher's gradebook, showing whether each student finished all their work, was added for comparison.

context.potentialUses: Predict which students need a check-in, so the app can email a parent.

fields.description: An ID for each row of data.
How the student turns in homework.
Whether the teacher's gradebook shows all 5 assignments done (Yes or No).
Assignments submitted in the app (out of 5).
When the student usually submitted in the app.
Minutes spent in the app this week.
